pages.text: The dedicated facility for making $(bold)wands$(). Wands decide a wizard's combat strength.

Place the Crafting Station → $(bold)aim your crosshair at it and right-click$() to open the panel → pick a wand blueprint (searchable by name) → set the quantity → $(bold)Submit$().$(br2)The task queue panel shows the wizards' crafting progress. One wand takes about $(bold)1 minute$() of channeling; batch orders process in queue order.
pages.title: Using It

pages.text: Wand bonuses apply $(bold)the moment they're equipped$() — Spell Power decides casting might, Work Speed decides building efficiency. Recipes have level gates; when the colony level is insufficient, the corresponding recipe stays locked. pages.title: Wands

pages.text: $(li)Finished wands go into the $(bold)warehouse$(); equip them on wizards in the $(l:wandscape:npc_guide)Wizard Panel$(/l). Wands can be swapped freely — one wand serves the whole squad.$(li)Wands never lose durability.$(li)Recipes at Level 20+ cost a lot of Metal and Dark elements — late-game savings goals.$(br2)$(l:wandscape:workstation_guide)Workstation (Decompose & Synthesize)$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:npc_guide)Wizard NPC Guide$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
